# AI Forward Deployed Engineer Program

> A live, mentor-led program by upGrad School of Technology that trains engineers
> to take AI from demo to production inside real businesses — discovery, build,
> deployment and ownership. Taught by Vishwa Mohan (Founder & CEO, upGrad School
> of Technology; ex-Oracle, Walmart, PayPal, LinkedIn).

This is a single-page site. Every link below is a section anchor on the home page.

## Start here

- [Home](/): program overview, who it is for, and the companies building FDE teams today.
- [Why FDE](/#why-fde): what a Forward Deployed Engineer is, why the role exists, and the deployment gap it closes.
- [Course intro](/#course-intro): the program's premise and what "industry-ready FDE" means in practice.
- [FAQ](/#faq): who the program is for, prerequisites, duration, cost, and who teaches it.

## Program

- [Curriculum](/#curriculum): nine phases — Production Software & Data Engineering; Applied AI I (LLM + RAG); Applied AI II (Agents & MCP); Backend & Enterprise Integration; Frontend & Operational Applications; Cloud, DevOps & LLMOps; System Design at Scale; Security, Reliability & Governance; The FDE Craft.
- [Projects](/#projects): the portfolio built during the program, including an ATS resume/JD matcher, an AI accessibility auditor, MindMapAI, PickFlick, a payroll processing engine, and a healthcare patient-queue system.
- [Certificate](/#certificate): the certificate of completion awarded at the end of the program.
- [Mentor](/#mentor): Vishwa Mohan's background and the companies he has built teams at.

## Access and pricing

- [Free course](/#free-course): the course content itself is free.
- [Why the paid platform](/#why-paid): what the ₹99 practice platform adds on top of the free course — labs, graded practice, and the hands-on environment.
